name: Hofstede Model of Four Cultural Dimensions
excerpt: The Hofstede Model analyzes cultural dimensions like individualism and power distance.
notes: The Hofstede Model of Four Cultural Dimensions analyzes cultural aspects such as individualism/collectivism, power distance, uncertainty avoidance, and masculinity/femininity.
